description: An expander for OSC'elot that turns eight of its mapping slots into a trigger and a CV output each. It goes immediately to the right of OSC'elot, or of another of these.

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V each time that controller's value changes.
That controller's value as a voltage, spread over the range chosen on the menu, which starts at -5V to 5V.
Every one of the eight triggers on one cable, one channel per controller.
Every one of the eight control voltages on one cable, one channel per controller.

notes: every output stays at 0V unless an OSC'elot, or another of these expanders, is immediately to its left.
the first expander carries the first eight of OSC'elot's mapping slots; a second one chained to its right carries the next eight, and so on.
the name of each mapped controller is drawn beside its pair of jacks, and POLY beside the pair at the top; the lettering is not a control.
menu: Configure CV — opens the three ways of setting the voltage span the CV outputs use.
Voltage Range: -1V to 1V, -3V to 3V, -5V to 5V, -10V to 10V, 0V to 1V, 0V to 3V, 0V to 5V, 0V to 10V — sets both ends of the CV span at once.
Start Voltage: -10 V, -5 V, -3 V, -1 V, 0 V, 1 V, 3 V, 5 V, 10 V — sets the voltage a controller at its lowest gives.
End Voltage: -10 V, -5 V, -3 V, -1 V, 0 V, 1 V, 3 V, 5 V, 10 V — sets the voltage a controller at its highest gives.
